• Broecker contributed significantly to the understanding of the planet's **carbon cycle** and its impact on climate systems, emphasizing the role of greenhouse gases.
 
• His groundbreaking work on the **"conveyor belt" model** of ocean circulation helped explain how oceans regulate Earth's climate.

questions.question: Utsav Charan Das, who passed away in March 2026, was a legendary exponent of which traditional folk dance?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghoda Nacha.**__

***__In News__**

__
 
• The renowned folk dance exponent **Utsav Charan Das** passed away on 1 March 2026 at the age of 78 in Puri, Odisha.
 
• He was a celebrated performer and teacher of **Ghoda Nacha (Horse Dance)**, a traditional folk dance primarily performed by the fishing community (Kaibarta) of Odisha.
 
• Spanning over six decades, his career was dedicated to preserving and popularizing this unique rural art form through his own troupe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Awards & Recognition__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri:** He was honored with the **Padma Shri** (India's fourth-highest civilian award) in **2020** for his distinguished service to the arts.
 
• **Other Honors:** He was also a recipient of the **Odisha Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** and a Senior Fellowship from the Ministry of Culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **About Ghoda Nacha__**

 
• **The Dance:** Also known as Chaiti Ghoda Nata*, it involves dancers performing inside a dummy horse made of bamboo and cloth.
 
• **Cultural Context:** It is traditionally performed during the month of **Chaitra** (March-April) and is associated with the worship of Goddess Basuli.
 
• **Elements:** The performance includes rhythmic movements, songs (dhuduki), and humorous dialogues between characters like Rauta and Rautani.
